correctness.rationale: The fixed parameter interval 1/phi<delta<1 ensures stable supports are exactly words of length-one and length-two positive blocks separated by single inactive vertices, with adjacent two-blocks forbidden (Misiak–Dziubiński classification). For k blocks and m length-two blocks, n=2k+m-1 and active count a=k+m, giving k=n-a+1, m=2a-n-1 and c_{n,a}=binom(k-m+1,m) on the stated feasible support. Independent breadth-first enumeration of all legal blocks up to n=40 matched every coefficient and the generating rational function F(x,y)=(xy+x^2y^2+x^4y^3)/(1-x^2y-x^5y^3). Perron/dominant denominator root r solves r^2+r^5=1. The nonnegative binomial coefficients have a uniform exponential Stirling profile h(alpha)=(2-3alpha)H((2alpha-1)/(2-3alpha)) on [1/2,3/5]. Polynomially many feasible a values plus attainable lattice approximants yield the full LDP upper/lower bounds after division by lambda^n. Strict h concavity and the root relation uniquely give alpha*=(1+3r^3)/(2+5r^3). Boundary h=0 is continuous; endpoints delta=1/phi and 1 excluded.
residual_risks: Uniform selection over DISTINCT stable profiles is not the measure induced by random-order dynamic absorption; interpretation must remain precise.
A finite n<=40 block-word check is corroboration; LDP rests on exact generating function and Stirling estimate.
